text:
Possibly, but it isn't confirmed yet.

Hansen/UMD mapped about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 on this 345.6 ha property (3.9% of its area). Other maps indicate the affected area was forest: JRC shows 98% of it as forest in 2020, and the MGAP 2021 map classes about 13.1 ha as native forest (0.4 ha outside mapped forest, no planted forest).

Limits on what this shows:
- **Not corroborated.** 2025 is the latest year of the series, so there is no later year to show the loss persisted. The assessment is pending.
- **Not necessarily deforestation.** Hansen loss covers any stand-replacing event, including fire, storm or harvest.
- **Cause, legality and responsibility** are not established.

So there is a likely native-forest loss candidate of about 13.5 ha, which needs follow-up with later-year data before it is treated as confirmed.
